title: MxAgile Feature Specification
description: Canonical feature specification grouping one or more requirements into a logical unit of work. Canonical location: specs/SPEC-NNN.yml. Primary key: ID. Consumed by build_artifact_index.py for IMPLEMENTED_BY edges (requirements list).

ID.description: Stable unique identifier. Primary key in the artifact index. Must match filename stem (SPEC-001.yml -> ID: SPEC-001).

description.description: High-level description of the feature, its purpose, and value.

requirements.description: IDs of all Requirement artifacts this spec implements. Creates IMPLEMENTED_BY edges: Requirement -> Spec. At least one requirement must be referenced.

status.description: draft: authored but not reviewed. accepted: approved, downstream work may begin. superseded: replaced by another spec.

behavior.description: Detailed behavior description consolidating the referenced requirements. Describes what the system does, not how.

business_rules.description: Specific business rules governing this feature.

out_of_scope.description: What this feature explicitly does not cover.

migrated_from.description: Source file path for migrated specs.

revision_status.description: How this spec was affected by the most recent accepted mockup revision. Set by Refinement-Agent after active-target transition. NEW: first created in this revision. REFINED: behavior or rules changed. PRESERVED: revision did not touch this spec. SUPERSEDED: replaced by a later spec.

refined_in_revision.description: Revision number (mockup.revision) in which this spec was last touched (NEW or REFINED).

implementation_effect.description: Action required by the Implementation-Agent for this spec as a result of the mockup revision. Mirrors the typed effect required_action enum. Set by Refinement-Agent.
